title: 54th Writers Guild of America Awards

{{Use mdy dates|date=February 2025}} {{WGA awards short description|works-year=2001}} {{Infobox film awards|number=54|award=WGA Awards|date=March 2, 2002|organizer=[[Writers Guild of America, East]] and the [[Writers Guild of America, West]]|last=[[53rd Writers Guild of America Awards|53rd]]|next=[[55th Writers Guild of America Awards|55th]]}} The '''54th [[Writers Guild of America Awards]]''' honored the best writing in film, television and radio of 2001. Nominees for television and radio were announced on January 16, 2002, while nominees for film were announced on February 7, 2002.{{cite web|url=https://variety.com/2002/film/awards/wga-touts-tyros-1117860395/|title=WGA touts tyros|last=McNary|first=Dave|date=February 7, 2002|website=Variety|access-date=March 11, 2019}} Winners were announced on March 2, 2002, in joint ceremonies at the [[Beverly Hilton Hotel]] in Beverly Hills, California and at [[The Pierre|The Pierre Hotel]] in New York City, New York. The ceremonies were hosted by [[Jeffrey Ross]] (Beverly Hilton) and [[Mort Sahl]] (The Pierre).{{cite web|url=https://variety.com/2002/film/awards/writers-guild-awards-gosford-park-mind-1117861680/|title=Writers Guild awards 'Gosford Park,' 'Mind'|last=McNary|first=Dave|last2=Oei|first2=Lily|date=March 2, 2002|website=Variety|access-date=March 11, 2019}} ==Winners and nominees== ===Notes=== * Nominees for television and radio were originally broadcast between September 1, 2000, and August 31, 2001.{{cite web|url=https://www.upi.com/Archives/2002/01/16/Nominees-for-54th-Annual-WGA-Awards/7721011157200/|title=Nominees for 54th Annual WGA Awards|date=January 16, 2002|website=UPI|access-date=March 11, 2019}} * Winners are in bold (some categories resulted in a tie, allowing two winners for some awards).{{cite web |url=https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2005-1996 |title=Writers Guild Awards Winners: 2005-1996 |work=wga.org |publisher=Writers Guild of America |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260217142826/https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2005-1996 |archive-date=2026-02-17 |access-date=2026-02-20 |url-status=live }}{{cite web|url=https://www.imdb.com/event/ev0000710/2002/1/|title=Writers Guild of America 2002 Awards|website=IMDb|access-date=March 11, 2019}} ===Film=== {| class=wikitable style="width=100%" |- !
